matt: Heads-up — nightly perf run flagged a mem-bandwidth regression on paged-fused-attn (attn_paged_fused_v3). ~18% throughput drop on 2k/4k seq workloads.
perf-bot: nightly/attn-bench job 2026-03-17-23:40 finished. attn_paged_fused_v3 regressed 17.8% median throughput vs baseline. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/nightly/2026-03-17/attn/
matt: nvprof snapshot I grabbed (relevant counters):
```
DRAM_READ_THROUGHPUT: 56.2 GB/s -> 71.1 GB/s
L2_HIT_RATE: 0.74 -> 0.61
shared_mem_utilization: 0.52 -> 0.28
stalled_mem_dep: 0.12 -> 0.35
```
arjun: interesting. could be KV-cache reloads. what were microbatch and batcher heuristics?
matt: nightly used microbatch=8, batcher policy=fixed-32, tiler params changed recently (64x32 -> 128x16) on fused path to reduce sharedmem pressure.
kai: that tiling trade-off reduces per-block shared usage but increases global reads per tile -> can blow up L2 reuse. i raised this concern in PR but perf looked ok on small seq.
olivia: nsight flame shows spike in stalled_mem_dep for stage2 kernels — aligns with more DRAM reads. also warp serialization up ~2.9x on hot kernels.
matt: repro command I used: `tools/bench/attn_bench --model gpt-medium --seq 2048 --batch 8 --microbatch 8 --mode paged-fused --tiling 128x16 --kvcache enabled`
arjun: i ran a quick A100 run with kvcache disabled and regression disappears (throughput back to baseline). suggests eviction + tiling interacting. when evictions happen, we re-fetch a lot.
kai: makes sense. when tile size increases, each tile touches more key blocks; combined w/ our LRU-ish kvcache we might thrash. occupancy dropped from 0.83 -> 0.46 after tiling change, so less parallelism masking mem latency.
olivia: proposal: revert tiler change on fused path in nightly to confirm. add kvcache per-key hit/miss counters to runtime and a bytes_from_global metric. also run canary with L2-prefetch enabled.
matt: i'll schedule revert for headless-nightly and attach the perf job. filing a ticket with logs and nvprof dump.
perf-bot: scheduled revert-tiler-patch to headless-nightly at 2012345700 — job started.
arjun: if revert fixes, next steps: 1) add kvcache telemetry (per-model, per-route hits/misses), 2) experiment with adaptive batching (let batcher increase microbatch when kvcache miss-rate high), 3) try a variant tiling 96x21 as middle ground.
kai: also test bumping blocks-per-sm to increase occupancy and run with `--l2-prefetch=1` to see L2 effect. small perf matrix: tilings x kvcache on/off x l2prefetch on/off x occupancy config.
matt: PR created: PERF-4621 — "investigate paged-fused attn mem-bandwidth regression" with artifacts + nvprof. I'll post results tomorrow after the revert job. :eyes:
olivia: SGTM. can ops add console alert for sudden bytes_from_global jumps per-model? that would speed future triage.
perf-bot: job headless-nightly revert-tiler-patch finished at 2012345728. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/nightly/2026-03-17/revert-tiler/ — running perf diff now.
matt: quick check — revert looks promising: throughput delta now ~+1% vs baseline (no regression). will run the full matrix next.
arjun: nice. when you run matrix, please include microbench with pinned streams to isolate L2 effects.
matt: noted. PR updated with matrix plan. closing loop tomorrow.
